description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Production Information of all Manufacture importers and traders shall be legible printed
reasoning: This gazette contains a direction issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, which establishes new regulatory requirements for product labeling. It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it involves the creation of subsidiary legislation (a statutory instrument/direction) that modifies the legal framework for businesses, specifying compliance requirements for manufacturers, importers, distributors, and traders.
